skill.description: Analyze comments and replies from a supplied Douyin video through SocialDataX to identify feedback themes, purchase concerns, unmet needs, and FAQ topics.
skill.summary: Turn retrieved Douyin comments into evidence-based feedback reports with clear sample limits.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: All 43 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown, documented service links, legitimate credential configuration, video identifiers, or readable Chinese text. A separate medium-severity supply-chain risk exists because the examples execute an unpinned external npm package through npx. No evidence of prompt injection or credential exfiltration was found in the supplied files; external package implementation was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples automatically execute the mutable socialdatax-skills@latest npm package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, document integrity verification, and align installation metadata with that version. Run the CLI with minimal privileges.

semantic_findings.description: Examples run npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest, allowing automatic download and execution of a mutable npm release. A compromised release could access the configured API key and local files with the agent's privileges.

content.user_title: Analyze Douyin Comments and Customer Needs
content.value_statement: Douyin comment threads can hide recurring questions, purchase concerns, and unmet needs. This skill guides SocialDataX retrieval and organizes returned comments into evidence-based findings and practical recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Guide comment retrieval from a Douyin content URL, share text, or video ID using the external SocialDataX CLI or configured MCP tools.
Retrieve replies for a known video and parent comment through the documented reply command or MCP tool.
Control pagination through page counts, item limits, and returned continuation tokens.
Organize returned feedback into themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, and FAQ topics.
Separate visible comment evidence from interpretation and translate findings into content, product, or customer-service recommendations.
Preserve partial results and resume retrieval with remaining limits and separate comment and reply tokens.
limitations: Retrieval requires a configured SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient provider balance.
CLI execution requires Node.js and npm; the external package is not bundled, and examples use the mutable latest release.
Results cover only returned comments and replies for supplied content; an empty continuation token does not prove complete coverage.
The documented workflow is read-only and does not log in, publish posts, like content, submit comments, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan Audience-Focused Content
use_cases.description: Review comments on a supplied video to identify recurring questions and propose follow-up topics grounded in visible feedback.

use_cases.title: Find Product Improvement Leads
use_cases.description: Group returned comments into pain points, purchase concerns, and unmet needs while distinguishing direct evidence from product hypotheses.

use_cases.title: Prepare Customer-Service FAQ Topics
use_cases.description: Extract recurring questions and concerns from comments and replies to prioritize FAQ topics and response review.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the first page of comments for [Douyin content URL]. Summarize recurring themes and questions. State the sample scope and quote only returned comments.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: review a small comment sample.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Purchase Concerns
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve up to [comment limit] comments for [video ID]. Group purchase concerns and unmet needs. Separate direct evidence from interpretations and suggest product questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: structure customer feedback with a clear retrieval limit.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a Reply Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: For [video ID] and [parent comment ID], retrieve up to [reply limit] replies. Track continuation tokens and summarize recurring questions. Draft evidence-based FAQ topics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: investigate a specific discussion thread.

prompt_templates.title: Recover a Partial Research Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [partial results] and [original retrieval limits]. Preserve existing comments and errors. Resume only with valid continuation tokens and remaining limits. Report coverage and prioritized recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: continue an interrupted analysis without restarting completed pages.

output_examples.input: Illustrative comments: 'Is there a smaller size?' and 'Can I buy a compact version?' Summarize needs and propose an action.
output: Scope: two supplied comments, not a platform-wide sample.
Theme: interest in smaller product sizes.
Evidence: 'Is there a smaller size?' and 'Can I buy a compact version?'
Interpretation: a compact option may address an unmet need; these comments do not establish overall demand.
Action: check existing size options and investigate the request in a larger sample.

output_examples.input: Illustrative run: a 60-comment request returned 40 comments before a network error. A valid continuation token remains available.
output: Coverage: 40 returned comments; retrieval is incomplete.
Recovery: preserve the comments and error, then resolve the network issue.
Remaining allowance: retrieve at most 20 more comments using the returned continuation token and original query.
Reporting: label conclusions as provisional until the planned sample is collected.

best_practices: Start with one page or an explicit item limit, then confirm any expansion that may consume additional provider credits.
Keep API keys in the configured environment and pass user input through argument arrays or correctly escaped shell arguments.
State collection scope, preserve continuation tokens, and distinguish quoted comments from interpretations and recommendations.
anti_patterns: Treating a first-page sample or empty continuation token as proof of complete audience coverage.
Inserting raw share text into a shell command or exposing the API key in prompts and reports.
Restarting partial runs from page one or enabling unlimited collection without considering cost and scope.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill accept?
faq.answer: Use a Douyin content URL, short link, share text, or video ID. Reply retrieval also needs the parent comment ID.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and provider balance. Use Node.js and npm for the CLI, or an existing integration exposing the documented MCP tools.

faq.question: Does it publish replies or change my account?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow retrieves comments and replies without login, posting, likes, comments, or account changes.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every comment?
faq.answer: Complete coverage is not guaranteed. Pagination follows returned tokens, and an empty token does not prove that every comment was retrieved.

faq.question: How are failed requests handled?
faq.answer: Preserve partial results and resume with valid tokens and remaining limits. Stop repeated retries for insufficient balance and use the documented provider billing page.

faq.question: Is the CLI implementation included in this skill?
faq.answer: No. The examples execute an external npm package using the mutable latest release. Pin and review a version before running it.
